global.intro_zh: 这七个 Owner 不是把现有 KMD 按源码目录切成七份，而是把未来 3–5 年会持续出现的新能力按问题域划分。基础 probe、submission、queue、scheduler、interrupt、MMIO/PCIe 是共同底座；Owner 负责在底座之上形成可独立演进、可测试、可交付的能力闭环。
global.intro_en: The seven Owners are not source-tree partitions. They divide future 3–5 year KMD capability growth by problem domain. Probe, submission, queues, basic scheduling, interrupts and MMIO/PCIe are shared foundations; each Owner builds an independently evolvable, testable capability loop above them.

layers.title_zh: 应用 / AI 框架 / Runtime
layers.desc_zh: 提出执行、内存、性能、隔离和可观测性需求。
layers.desc_en: Express execution, memory, performance, isolation and observability requirements.

layers.desc_zh: 把用户态对象和策略转换为 KMD uAPI。
layers.desc_en: Translate user-space objects and policy into KMD uAPI operations.

layers.title_zh: GPU KMD 七个 Owner 能力层
layers.title_en: Seven GPU KMD Owner capability domains
layers.desc_zh: Memory、Virtualization、Power、RAS、Multi-GPU、Observability、Firmware 彼此独立但通过对象生命周期和 generation 协作。
layers.desc_en: Memory, Virtualization, Power, RAS, Multi-GPU, Observability and Firmware remain distinct but coordinate through object lifetimes and generations.
Probe/init, submission/execution, contexts/queues, basic scheduling, interrupts and MMIO/PCIe.

layers.title_zh: GPU HW / FW / PCIe / IOMMU / Memory
layers.title_en: GPU HW / FW / PCIe / IOMMU / memory
layers.desc_zh: 真正执行、地址转换、通信、功耗管理和错误上报的硬件基础。
layers.desc_en: Hardware mechanisms for execution, translation, communication, power management and error reporting.

memory.beginner_zh: Memory Owner 解决的是“GPU 如何安全、快速地访问数据，以及数据应该在哪里”。它不只是分配显存，而是覆盖 GPU 虚拟地址、页表、缺页、CPU/GPU 共享地址空间、页迁移、回收以及多 GPU 共享内存。随着 GPU 从固定显存对象走向 pageable / unified memory，Memory 会逐渐成为 KMD 中最像 Linux MM 子系统的长期方向。
memory.beginner_en: The Memory Owner answers how the GPU safely and efficiently accesses data and where that data should reside. It covers far more than VRAM allocation: GPU virtual addresses, page tables, faults, CPU/GPU shared address spaces, migration, reclaim and multi-GPU memory sharing. As GPUs move toward pageable and unified memory, this becomes one of the most MM-like long-term KMD domains.
memory.why_zh: 基础 BO/VRAM 分配只能解决“先分配再提交”的静态模型。AI、oversubscription、共享虚拟地址和多 GPU 会要求页面在运行中被 fault、迁移、回收和重新映射，因此必须形成独立的地址空间与 residency correctness 能力。
memory.why_en: Basic BO/VRAM allocation handles a static allocate-then-submit model. AI, oversubscription, shared virtual addressing and multi-GPU require pages to fault, migrate, reclaim and remap while workloads run, so address-space and residency correctness become independent capabilities.
flow_zh: GPU 访问 VA
页表命中：直接访问
页表缺失/权限异常：产生 recoverable fault
通过 PASID/VM 找到进程 mm
HMM 检查 CPU 页表并 pin/migrate 页面
更新 GPU PTE
完成 TLB invalidate
重新校验 notifier/reset generation
fault replay，workload 继续
flow_en: HMM checks CPU page tables and pins/migrates pages

roadmap.zh: GPUVM correctness：页表对象、VMID/PASID、TLB ordering、生命周期。
roadmap.en: GPUVM correctness: page-table objects, VMID/PASID, TLB ordering and lifetime.

roadmap.zh: Recoverable fault + HMM + migration + replay，解决 munmap/process exit/reset race。
roadmap.en: Recoverable fault + HMM + migration + replay, including munmap/process-exit/reset races.

roadmap.zh: Oversubscription、eviction/reclaim、4K/64K/2M migration granularity 与 NUMA policy。
roadmap.en: Oversubscription, eviction/reclaim, migration granularity and NUMA policy.

roadmap.zh: SVA/ATS/PRI、multi-GPU UVM、peer residency、tiered/CXL memory 和 memory QoS。
roadmap.en: SVA/ATS/PRI, multi-GPU UVM, peer residency, tiered/CXL memory and memory QoS.

memory.boundary_zh: Memory 决定地址映射、页生命周期和 residency；Multi-GPU 提供拓扑/transport；RAS 决定 reset/recovery 语义；Firmware 只提供 FW 管理的 memory service，不拥有 Linux MM policy。
memory.boundary_en: Memory owns mappings, page lifetime and residency. Multi-GPU supplies topology/transport, RAS owns recovery semantics, and Firmware exposes FW-managed memory services without owning Linux MM policy.

virt.beginner_zh: Virtualization / Security Owner 解决的是“多个租户、VM 或 VF 如何安全地共享同一 GPU，同时让每个租户感觉自己拥有可控的一部分 GPU”。这里的难点不是创建一个 PCI VF，而是把 GPU 特有资源——VMID、queue、doorbell、interrupt、engine、memory、FW resource——做成可隔离、可重置、可计量的生命周期。
virt.beginner_en: The Virtualization / Security Owner asks how multiple tenants, VMs or VFs can safely share one GPU while each sees a controlled GPU slice. The hard part is not creating a PCI VF; it is making GPU-specific resources such as VMIDs, queues, doorbells, interrupts, engines, memory and firmware resources isolated, resettable and accountable.
virt.why_zh: GPU 的状态远多于普通 PCI BAR。只有 PCI SR-IOV capability 但没有 GPU resource partition、reset isolation 和 PF↔VF control plane，并不能形成真正可用的 GPU 虚拟化。
virt.why_en: A GPU carries much more state than PCI BARs. PCI SR-IOV capability without GPU resource partitioning, reset isolation and a PF↔VF control plane is not a complete GPU virtualization solution.
flow_zh: PF 探测硬件 virtualization capability
创建 VF/guest ownership
分配 VMID/queue/doorbell/interrupt/memory/engine
建立 IOMMU 隔离和 PF↔VF admin channel
VF 独立运行并计量
错误或 FLR 时冻结 VF 访问
清理/重建 VF resource
向 guest/VMM 发布恢复结果
flow_en: Provision VMIDs, queues, doorbells, interrupts, memory and engines
Establish IOMMU isolation and PF↔VF admin channel

roadmap.zh: Capability assessment + VFIO ownership/reset/IOMMU isolation。
roadmap.en: Capability assessment plus VFIO ownership/reset/IOMMU isolation.

roadmap.zh: SR-IOV PF/VF provisioning、PF↔VF ABI、VF FLR 与 resource accounting。
roadmap.en: SR-IOV PF/VF provisioning, PF↔VF ABI, VF FLR and resource accounting.

roadmap.zh: 细粒度 engine/memory partition、vGPU、live migration。
roadmap.en: Fine-grained engine/memory partitioning, vGPU and live migration.

roadmap.zh: secure boot、scrub/zeroization、measurement、attestation、confidential GPU。
roadmap.en: Secure boot, scrub/zeroization, measurement, attestation and confidential GPU.

virt.boundary_zh: Virtualization 拥有租户隔离与资源生命周期；Memory 提供每租户 GPUVM；RAS 提供 recovery primitive；Firmware 提供 PF/VF control service；Security 关注信任边界而不是普通调度策略。
virt.boundary_en: Virtualization owns tenant isolation and resource lifetime. Memory supplies per-tenant GPUVM, RAS supplies recovery primitives, Firmware supplies PF/VF control services, and Security owns trust boundaries rather than ordinary scheduling policy.

power.beginner_zh: Power / Performance Owner 解决的是“GPU 什么时候算忙、应该以什么频率运行、什么时候可以进入低功耗，以及性能/功耗策略怎样建立在可信 measurement 上”。它连接 scheduler、FW、clock/power controller、runtime PM、thermal 和 PCIe ASPM。
power.beginner_en: The Power / Performance Owner defines when the GPU is busy, what frequency it should run at, when it may enter low-power states and how performance/power policy is built on trustworthy measurements. It connects scheduling, firmware, clock/power controllers, runtime PM, thermal management and PCIe ASPM.
power.why_zh: 直接做 DVFS governor 容易得到错误策略，因为 KMD 首先必须知道谁在持有 active lifetime、GPU 是否真的 idle、异步 IRQ/FW/fault worker 是否仍会访问硬件，以及 suspend/resume 需要保存恢复哪些状态。
power.why_en: Jumping straight to a DVFS governor is risky. The KMD must first know who owns active lifetime, whether the GPU is truly idle, whether asynchronous IRQ/FW/fault work may still touch hardware, and what state suspend/resume must preserve.
flow_zh: KMD 统计 job/engine busy
统一计算 utilization/residency
策略选择 OPP/frequency
FW/HW 调整 clock/voltage
无 active user 时关闭 admission 并 drain
进入 runtime suspend / D-state
新 work 到来恢复电源和 FW service
恢复寄存器/上下文后重新 admission
flow_en: When no active users remain, quiesce and drain
Resume power and FW services on new work

roadmap.zh: Busy/idle、per-engine utilization、frequency/power telemetry。
roadmap.en: Busy/idle, per-engine utilization and frequency/power telemetry.

roadmap.zh: Runtime PM + system suspend/resume + 完整 async-user quiesce matrix。
roadmap.en: Runtime PM, system suspend/resume and a complete async-user quiesce matrix.

roadmap.zh: DVFS/OPP、clock/power gating、thermal/power cap。
roadmap.en: DVFS/OPP, clock/power gating and thermal/power caps.

roadmap.zh: workload-aware policy、memory bandwidth/QoS、平台级能效协同。
roadmap.en: Workload-aware policy, memory-bandwidth/QoS and platform-level energy coordination.

power.boundary_zh: Power 拥有 active lifetime 和 power policy；Observability 提供 measurement；Firmware 执行 FW-managed PM service；scheduler 提供 workload 信号但不拥有平台 PM 生命周期。
power.boundary_en: Power owns active lifetime and power policy. Observability supplies measurements, Firmware executes FW-managed PM services, and the scheduler supplies workload signals without owning platform PM lifetime.

ras.beginner_zh: Reliability / Recovery / RAS Owner 解决的是“GPU 出错以后如何保存证据、判断影响范围、阻止错误扩散、恢复服务，并让其他模块知道旧状态已经失效”。它从 hang watchdog 一直延伸到 engine/context reset、FW crash、ECC、PCIe AER 和生产级健康状态。
ras.beginner_en: The Reliability / Recovery / RAS Owner defines how the driver preserves evidence after a fault, determines scope, contains damage, restores service and tells other modules that old state has become stale. It spans hang watchdogs, engine/context resets, firmware crashes, ECC, PCIe AER and production health state.
ras.why_zh: 简单 `reset_gpu()` 会丢掉现场，并产生 submit-vs-reset、fault-vs-reset、FW completion-vs-reset 等 race。生产级驱动必须把 evidence、admission、generation、restore 和 health contract 分开设计。
ras.why_en: A simple reset_gpu() loses evidence and creates submit-vs-reset, fault-vs-reset and firmware-completion-vs-reset races. Production drivers need explicit evidence, admission, generation, restore and health contracts.
flow_zh: heartbeat/IRQ/FW 检测异常
立即冻结 register/ring/VM/FW log 证据
分类 fault scope/severity
发布 QUIESCING 并关闭新访问
drain 正在运行的访问
推进 recovery generation
执行 engine/FW/device recovery
恢复或杀死受影响对象
发布 NORMAL/FAILED 并重新 admission
flow_en: Publish QUIESCING and close new access

roadmap.zh: Heartbeat/watchdog + frozen snapshot + devcoredump + reset reason。
roadmap.en: Heartbeat/watchdog, frozen snapshot, devcoredump and reset reason.

roadmap.zh: Recovery Admission/State/Sequence + full-device reset restore。
roadmap.en: Recovery Admission/State/Sequence plus full-device reset restore.

roadmap.zh: engine/context/queue 粒度 recovery、FW crash recovery、job replay。
roadmap.en: Engine/context/queue recovery, firmware crash recovery and job replay.

roadmap.zh: ECC page retirement、AER、fabric health、fleet/management-facing GPU health。
roadmap.en: ECC page retirement, AER, fabric health and fleet/management-facing GPU health.

ras.boundary_zh: RAS 拥有 failure semantics 和 recovery policy；Observability 提供 trace/telemetry；Firmware 提供 reset/log primitive；Memory/Virtualization 根据 recovery generation 处理自己的 stale object。
ras.boundary_en: RAS owns failure semantics and recovery policy. Observability supplies trace/telemetry, Firmware supplies reset/log primitives, and Memory/Virtualization invalidate their own stale objects using recovery generations.

multi.beginner_zh: Multi-GPU / P2P / Fabric Owner 解决的是“系统里有哪些 GPU、它们如何连接、彼此能否直接访问、链路状态如何变化，以及上层如何在不理解具体 PCIe/UALink/fabric 细节的情况下使用这些能力”。它是从单卡 KMD 走向多加速器系统软件的基础。
multi.beginner_en: The Multi-GPU / P2P / Fabric Owner defines which GPUs exist, how they are connected, whether they can directly access one another, how link state changes and how upper layers consume those capabilities without knowing every PCIe/UALink/fabric detail. It is the foundation for moving from single-GPU drivers to multi-accelerator systems.
multi.why_zh: 一个 `can_peer_access[gpu0][gpu1]` 的 bool 很快不够：真实系统有多个 port、PCIe switch、NUMA、方向性 capability、peer reset、remote endpoint 和不同 transport。必须先建立稳定 topology/control model。
multi.why_en: A can_peer_access boolean quickly becomes insufficient. Real systems have multiple ports, PCIe switches, NUMA, directional capabilities, peer reset, remote endpoints and different transports, so a stable topology/control model is required first.
flow_zh: 枚举 GPU 并分配稳定 logical/physical identity
构建 PCIe/NUMA/fabric topology
发现 endpoint/port/peer
计算方向性 P2P capability + failure reason
建立 peer BAR/PTE 或 P2P DMA path
监控 link/connection state
连接 reset 时推进 generation 并撤销 stale peer handle
向 Memory 暴露 transport 供 shared VM/UVM 使用
flow_en: Enumerate GPUs and assign stable identities
Compute directional P2P capabilities and failure reasons
Create peer BAR/PTE or P2P DMA paths
Advance generations and revoke stale handles on reset
Expose transport capabilities to Memory for shared VM/UVM

roadmap.zh: Enumeration、stable identity、topology、visibility/affinity、P2P matrix。
roadmap.en: Enumeration, stable identity, topology, visibility/affinity and P2P matrix.

roadmap.zh: endpoint/port/peer、peer BAR/PTE、P2P DMA、cross-GPU dma-buf。
roadmap.en: Endpoint/port/peer modeling, peer BAR/PTE, P2P DMA and cross-GPU dma-buf.

roadmap.zh: link health、connection reset、remote interrupt/TLB 等 fabric control primitive。
roadmap.en: Link health, connection reset and fabric control primitives such as remote interrupt/TLB.

roadmap.zh: shared VM、multi-GPU UVM、placement policy 和大规模 fabric。
roadmap.en: Shared VM, multi-GPU UVM, placement policy and large-scale fabric.

multi.boundary_zh: Multi-GPU 拥有 topology、reachability 和 transport；Memory 拥有 page residency/migration；RAS 拥有 failure semantics；Virtualization 决定 tenant 可见 topology 与授权。
multi.boundary_en: Multi-GPU owns topology, reachability and transport. Memory owns page residency/migration, RAS owns failure semantics, and Virtualization controls tenant-visible topology and authorization.

obs.beginner_zh: Observability / Profiling Owner 解决的是“GPU 系统发生了什么、发生在谁身上、为什么慢、为什么挂，以及怎样以低开销把 UMD/KMD/FW/GPU 的事件串成同一条时间线”。它不是 debugfs 集合，而是稳定事件模型、对象身份、software counters、eBPF、PMU 和 profiler 的共同基础。
obs.beginner_en: The Observability / Profiling Owner answers what happened in the GPU system, to whom, why it was slow or failed, and how UMD/KMD/FW/GPU events can be correlated on one low-overhead timeline. It is not a collection of debugfs files; it is the shared foundation for stable event identity, software counters, eBPF, PMU and profilers.
obs.why_zh: 没有统一 ID 和时间线时，scheduler 看 queue、Memory 看 PASID/VM、FW 看 seq、profiler 看 counter，事故发生后无法关联。越晚补统一 schema，兼容成本越高。
obs.why_en: Without unified IDs and timelines, scheduling sees queues, Memory sees PASID/VM, Firmware sees sequences and profilers see counters, but incidents cannot be correlated. The later a stable schema is introduced, the higher the compatibility cost.
flow_zh: 各 KMD subsystem 产生稳定 event + object ID
always-on software counter 聚合低成本健康指标
tracepoint 暴露关键状态转换
eBPF/trace 工具动态过滤和关联
FW event 使用同一 generation/seq 对齐
PMU/HW trace 提供微架构 sample
统一 timestamp/correlation 合并 timeline
profiler/RAS/Power 消费同一 telemetry service
flow_en: KMD subsystems emit stable events and object IDs
Always-on software counters aggregate low-cost health metrics
eBPF/trace tools filter and correlate dynamically
Firmware events align through shared generation/sequence

roadmap.zh: Stable object/event ID + software counters + tracepoints。
roadmap.en: Stable object/event IDs, software counters and tracepoints.

roadmap.zh: BTF/CO-RE/eBPF dynamic diagnostics，GPUVM/fault/migration timeline。
roadmap.en: BTF/CO-RE/eBPF dynamic diagnostics and GPUVM/fault/migration timelines.

roadmap.zh: PMU discovery、sampling/multiplexing、per-process/context profiling、perf_event。
roadmap.en: PMU discovery, sampling/multiplexing, per-process/context profiling and perf_event.

roadmap.zh: UMD/KMD/FW/GPU unified timeline、programmable hooks 和自动诊断。
roadmap.en: Unified UMD/KMD/FW/GPU timelines, programmable hooks and automated diagnostics.

obs.boundary_zh: Observability 提供事实、measurement 和关联机制，不拥有 RAS recovery policy、Power governor policy 或 Memory migration policy；这些 Owner 消费 observability 数据。
obs.boundary_en: Observability supplies facts, measurements and correlation mechanisms; it does not own RAS recovery policy, Power governor policy or Memory migration policy. Those Owners consume observability data.

fw.beginner_zh: Firmware / Control Plane Owner 解决的是“KMD 与 GPU 内部 FW 如何建立长期稳定、可版本演进、可恢复的控制关系”。现代 GPU 越来越多 init、PM、reset、scheduler、telemetry 都由 FW 管理，因此 KMD 不能把 FW 当成一个启动时下载的 blob，而要把它当成独立 control-plane peer。
fw.beginner_en: The Firmware / Control Plane Owner defines how the KMD establishes a stable, versioned and recoverable control relationship with internal GPU firmware. Modern GPUs move more init, PM, reset, scheduling and telemetry into firmware, so firmware must be treated as a control-plane peer rather than a blob loaded only at boot.
fw.why_zh: 如果每个 KMD 模块直接解析 raw FW message、自己做 timeout、自己判断 `fw_ready`，FW 一次 ABI 升级或 restart 就会让所有模块同时失效。需要 transport、parser、version translation、capability、generation 和 state reconciliation 的独立层。
fw.why_en: If every KMD subsystem directly parses raw firmware messages, implements its own timeout and checks its own fw_ready bit, one ABI upgrade or firmware restart breaks everything. A dedicated transport, parser, version translation, capability, generation and reconciliation layer is needed.
flow_zh: GPU reset 后启动 secure FW/devinit
KMD 与 FW 完成 handshake
协商 ABI version/capability
raw message 经过 parser/validator/translation
上层通过 stable internal service 发 async request
seq + generation 匹配 completion/timeout
FW restart 时旧 request/resource 全部 stale
重新 handshake、reconcile ownership 并恢复 service readiness
flow_en: Boot secure firmware/devinit after GPU reset
Parse, validate and translate raw messages
Upper layers issue async requests through stable services
Match completions/timeouts using sequence and generation
Invalidate old requests/resources on FW restart
Re-handshake, reconcile ownership and restore service readiness

roadmap.zh: Versioned async protocol、sequence/timeout/error、capability negotiation。
roadmap.en: Versioned async protocol, sequence/timeout/error handling and capability negotiation.

roadmap.zh: Parser/validator、stable property/service API、boot/reset generation、state reconciliation。
roadmap.en: Parser/validator, stable property/service APIs, boot/reset generations and state reconciliation.

roadmap.zh: FW-centric init/PM/reset/HW scheduler、health/log、upgrade/rollback。
roadmap.en: FW-centric init/PM/reset/HW scheduling, health/logging and upgrade/rollback.

roadmap.zh: 跨 PF/VF、多 GPU/fabric 的 FW control plane、安全认证和更强 resource ownership。
roadmap.en: PF/VF and multi-GPU/fabric firmware control planes, authentication and stronger resource ownership.

fw.boundary_zh: Firmware Owner 拥有 KMD↔FW protocol、lifecycle 和 control service；各功能 Owner 仍拥有自己的 policy 与语义，例如 Memory migration policy、Power governor、RAS classification。
fw.boundary_en: Firmware owns the KMD↔FW protocol, lifecycle and control services. Functional Owners still own their policies and semantics, such as Memory migration policy, Power governors and RAS classification.
